source_change: Temporary board_profile_export rustc cfg in starry-kernel debugfs exporter; no Cargo feature change
effect: Changing the temporary exporter gate from Cargo feature to rustc cfg restored the ordinary crate identity, but both hot futex functions still have the exporter-enabled CFG hash. The no-exporter candidate would discard their profile counts.
decision: Reject before board training. Move counter export outside the four profiled crates while keeping the starry_kernel item set and source identical between training and production, or use an external memory capture route.
